Official document (PDF) · Meeting record S/PV.3043

Resolution 737 (1992) of 29 January 1992

The Security Council,

Having examined the application of the Republic of Uzbekistan for admission to the United Nations, 377

Recommends to the General Assembly that the Republic of Uzbekistan be admitted to membership in the United Nations.

Adopted without a vote at the 3043rd meeting
